$comment: Repository settings every managed repo gets (PATCH /repos/{owner}/{repo}). A repo overrides any key in its own .github/repo-settings.json. Keys starting with $ are documentation and are never sent. History is linear, with no merge commits: work PRs are squash-merged into dev (the PR title becomes the commit); the dev → main release PR is never merged with a button — its `ship` label makes the Release workflow fast-forward main to dev. Merge commits and rebase merges are off: rebase rewrites dev's commits, so main and dev would diverge.
